name: Dragapult + Dreepy, saved 2026-10-15
rules: With both Dreepy home and its attack ready, Dragapult's next action (an attack, or a step toward its target) fires them instead. Firing counts as an attack: it waits its full attack cooldown at the start of a fight.
Targets: only enemies outside the 3x3 around Dragapult, farthest first, one Dreepy each. One far enemy = one Dreepy; none = it just attacks.

Crash: the Dreepy streaks out (white trail, small to full size), lands on the target's square, deals its landing hit, stuns it 0.5s and shoves it to a free square next to it (left, right, back, forward, then diagonals). A shield breaks instead; no room or an untouchable target = it lands beside it.
Distracted: once the stun wears off, the target drops whoever it was attacking and attacks the Dreepy right away, until it faints (a newer pull, like Amoonguss's, takes over).
Dreepy fight as melee Pokémon until they faint. A knocked-out Dreepy is knocked back from the hit and arcs home in 0.5s. Until both are home, Dragapult attacks normally.
Fairness: darts fire at the end of the tick, first Dreepy of every Dragapult before any second, aiming and landing from start-of-tick positions; a Dragapult knocked out that tick still fires.
